vendor_checklist.name: Willowbrook Botanical Gardens, Austin TX Management
key_questions_to_ask: What is the noise curfew for outdoor music amplification?
Are we required to use your preferred vendor list, or can we bring outside vendors?
What is the exact load-in and load-out time window for decor setup?
What is the backup inclement weather plan for outdoor ceremonies?
vendor_checklist.notes: Includes tables, chairs, and dedicated bridal suite.

vendor_checklist.name: Artisan Harvest Catering
key_questions_to_ask: Does the per-person quote include service staff, bartenders, and cleanup?
How do you handle dietary restrictions (vegan, gluten-free, nut allergies)?
Can we supply our own alcohol with a corkage fee, or must it be purchased through you?
Do you provide cake-cutting service and late-night snack options?
vendor_checklist.notes: Estimated at ~$75 per guest all-inclusive.

vendor_checklist.name: Lumière Wedding Studios
key_questions_to_ask: Do you include a second shooter for dual-angle coverage?
What is the turnaround time for receiving the sneak peek gallery vs full high-res album?
Do we receive full printing rights to all edited digital photos?
Have you shot at our venue before, and what are your favorite portrait spots?
vendor_checklist.notes: Request 8-10 hours coverage including prep and golden hour portraits.

vendor_checklist.name: SoundWave Entertainment
key_questions_to_ask: Do you provide separate audio setups for ceremony, cocktail hour, and dance floor?
How do you accommodate a 'Do Not Play' list and crowd song requests?
Do you bring wireless lapel microphones for the officiant and vows?
vendor_checklist.notes: Ask about intelligent dance floor wash lighting package.

vendor_checklist.name: Botanica Floral Art
key_questions_to_ask: Which blooms are in season locally to maximize lushness within budget?
Can ceremony floral installations (e.g. arch) be repurposed for the sweetheart table?
Do you handle breakdown and vessel collection at the end of the night?
vendor_checklist.notes: Theme palette: Boho Woodland & Terracotta Sunset.

personalized_ideas.title: Interactive Audio Guestbook with Vintage Rotary Phone
personalized_ideas.description: Set up a classic vintage rotary telephone where guests pick up the receiver, hear a recorded welcome from you, and leave heartfelt audio messages and toasts that you can keep as an audio vinyl record forever.

personalized_ideas.title: His, Hers & Ours Signature Cocktail Trio + Mocktail Flight
personalized_ideas.description: Feature tailored drinks like 'The Botanical Sparkler' (elderflower, prosecco, rosemary sprig) and an alcohol-free 'Spiced Orchard Spritz' using locally sourced fruits matching Boho Woodland & Terracotta Sunset.

personalized_ideas.title: High-Impact Ceremony Arch Repurposing
personalized_ideas.description: Have your day-of coordinator or florist move the ceremony flower arch behind the sweetheart table during cocktail hour, doubling its visual impact without paying for two expensive statement pieces.

personalized_ideas.title: Disposable Camera Scavenger Hunt / QR Live Gallery
personalized_ideas.description: Place instant cameras or a personalized QR code on every table with a playful prompt card: 'Snap the biggest smile', 'Catch the best dance floor spin', 'Capture a table clinking glasses'.

personalized_ideas.title: Midnight Gourmet Pretzel & Mini Milkshake Cart
personalized_ideas.description: Right when dancing hits its peak at 10 PM, wheel out warm Bavarian soft pretzels with artisan mustard dips and miniature dessert milkshakes to recharge the crowd.

evt-1a0a010e.ai_summary_and_tips: Planner Pro Tip: With a guest count of 120 and a $28,000 budget (~$233/guest), your highest leverage area is the venue and catering package. Booking an all-inclusive or BYO-beverage venue can save up to 18% in administrative and corkage fees. Always safeguard your 7% contingency reserve ($1,960) for final-week headcount adjustments.

vendor_checklist.name: Skyline Loft & Terrace, Downtown Booking
key_questions_to_ask: Is there an auxiliary input or Bluetooth connectivity for custom playlists?
Can we bring our own specialty birthday cake without an exorbitant plating charge?
What is the policy for hanging banners, neon signs, and balloon garlands?
vendor_checklist.notes: Confirm private bartender inclusion.

vendor_checklist.name: BiteSize Gourmet Grazing Co.
key_questions_to_ask: Do you provide grazing table presentation boards, warming trays, and stylish disposable utensils?
Can you craft 3 vegetarian and gluten-free savory options?
What is the shelf life/replenishment schedule during a 4-hour party?
vendor_checklist.notes: Plan for 6-8 heavy appetizers per guest.

vendor_checklist.name: Sweet Sculptures Bakery
key_questions_to_ask: Can you create a custom topper or edible photo print relating to the theme?
What flavor pairings do you recommend (e.g., Salted Caramel Dulce de Leche or Raspberry Lemon)?
Do you offer refrigerated delivery directly to the venue?
vendor_checklist.notes: Color accents: #06B6D4 and #FACC15.

vendor_checklist.name: FlashPop 360 & Glitz Booths
key_questions_to_ask: Does the booth include instant SMS/AirDrop video sharing for social media?
Can the physical printouts be branded with the guest-of-honor's name and celebration logo?
Does an attendant stay with the booth throughout the active hours?
vendor_checklist.notes: Ask for glam filter and custom video boomerang option.

personalized_ideas.title: Custom LED Neon Name Sign Backdrop
personalized_ideas.description: Commission an illuminated neon sign of the birthday person's nickname or catchphrase, mounted over a lush balloon installation. After the party, they take it home to hang in their living room or office!

personalized_ideas.title: Hilarious 'Roast & Toast' Video Trivia Game
personalized_ideas.description: Before the party, crowdsource 5 funny questions about the birthday honoree. Run a rapid-fire smartphone trivia round (Kahoot style) with silly prizes for whoever knows them best.

personalized_ideas.title: Mixology Cocktail Lab Station
personalized_ideas.description: Set up an interactive DIY garnish bar with dehydrated citrus wheels, smoked rosemary, edible glitter, and flavored syrups next to pre-batched craft spirits.

personalized_ideas.title: Giant Polarized 'Year of You' Memory Board
personalized_ideas.description: Collect photos from childhood, teenage years, and college up to present day, pinning them chronologically with blank speech bubbles for guests to write hilarious memories.

evt-88f36486.ai_summary_and_tips: Party Planner Tip: For an unforgettable birthday with 45 guests, focus spending where guests dwell most: great music, uninterrupted drinks, and an energetic centerpiece (like the photo booth or neon lounge). Finger foods beat a formal sit-down meal for keeping conversation flowing and guests mingling freely!

vendor_checklist.name: Community Sound & Stage Rentals
key_questions_to_ask: Does the rental include generator power or do we hook into municipal power boxes?
Is an experienced sound technician on-site all day to mic multiple performance groups?
What is the wind load rating for the canopy stage cover in case of gusts?
vendor_checklist.notes: Includes 12x16 mobile stage, 4 PA speakers, and 6 wireless microphones.

vendor_checklist.name: City Parks & Recreation Department
key_questions_to_ask: Are police or traffic control officers required for pedestrian crosswalks?
What is the deadline for submitting certificate of additional insured (COI)?
Are food truck fire marshal inspections conducted prior to opening?
vendor_checklist.notes: Street closure approval requires neighbor signatures on file.

vendor_checklist.name: GreenEvent Clean & Restrooms
key_questions_to_ask: How many ADA-compliant accessible portable restrooms are recommended for 300+ guests?
Do you provide clearly labeled triple-stream sorting bins (Compost, Recycling, Landfill)?
What is the dispatch schedule for emptying bins during peak hours?
vendor_checklist.notes: Includes handwashing stations with foot-pump dispensers.

vendor_checklist.name: WonderPlay Inflatables & Face Art
key_questions_to_ask: Are all operators certified and carry active commercial liability insurance?
What are the age group restrictions for the obstacle course bounce house?
What safety protocols are followed in case of sudden high winds or rain?
vendor_checklist.notes: Reserve 2 face painters and 1 interactive obstacle castle.

personalized_ideas.title: Collaborative 'Voices of Our Neighborhood' Canvas Mural
personalized_ideas.description: Erect an 8x16 foot freestanding wooden canvas where attendees of all ages paint what community means to them under the guidance of a local muralist. Once completed, donate it to the local library or community center.

personalized_ideas.title: Zero-Waste Hydration Station & BYO Water Bottle Incentive
personalized_ideas.description: Partner with a local water filtration supplier to offer chilled fruit-infused water refill stations. Give out raffle tickets for local merchant gift baskets to anyone who brings a reusable bottle.

personalized_ideas.title: Neighborhood 'Cook-Off / Bake-Off' Showdown
personalized_ideas.description: Host a friendly chili, pie, or salsa competition where community members can pay $5 for a tasting spoon to sample all entries and vote for the 'People's Choice Champion'. Proceeds offset permit fees!

personalized_ideas.title: Cultural Storytelling & Youth Talent Showcase
personalized_ideas.description: Dedicate a 90-minute stage block to youth poetry, acoustic folk music, and senior community members sharing history and folklore about how the neighborhood was built.

evt-691186af.ai_summary_and_tips: Community Organizer Pro Tip: For public community events with 400+ projected attendees, safety, sanitation, and municipal permissions are your absolute non-negotiables. Engage local small businesses early to sponsor specific zones (e.g. 'Kid's Zone sponsored by Main St Bakery') to offset equipment costs and multiply neighborhood turnout!

personalized_ideas.title: High-Impact Ceremony Arch Repurposing
personalized_ideas.description: Have your day-of coordinator or florist move the ceremony flower arch behind the sweetheart table during cocktail hour, doubling its visual impact without paying for two expensive statement pieces.

personalized_ideas.title: Disposable Camera Scavenger Hunt / QR Live Gallery
personalized_ideas.description: Place instant cameras or a personalized QR code on every table with a playful prompt card: 'Snap the biggest smile', 'Catch the best dance floor spin', 'Capture a table clinking glasses'.

personalized_ideas.title: Midnight Gourmet Pretzel & Mini Milkshake Cart
personalized_ideas.description: Right when dancing hits its peak at 10 PM, wheel out warm Bavarian soft pretzels with artisan mustard dips and miniature dessert milkshakes to recharge the crowd.

evt-cd77298b.ai_summary_and_tips: Planner Pro Tip: With a guest count of 10 and a ₹10,000 budget (~₹1,000/guest), your highest leverage area is the venue and catering package. Booking an all-inclusive or BYO-beverage venue can save up to 18% in administrative and corkage fees. Always safeguard your 7% contingency reserve (₹700) for final-week headcount adjustments.
